gui.kve.code.diag.unmatched_closing: This '%s' is closing something that was never opened - either it's extra, or an opening one is missing further up the file.
gui.kve.code.diag.unterminated_string: This %s opens a text string that never closes on the same line - the closing quote is probably missing. (If that was intentional, use backticks ` instead so it can span multiple lines.)

gui.kve.code.plain.class_cast: The script treated a value as if it were a different type than it actually is - an id is probably pointing at the wrong table/recipe/object.
gui.kve.code.plain.const_redeclaration: This script declared a value with 'const' or 'let' inside something that runs more than once (an event that can fire repeatedly, like an entity spawning) - the script engine doesn't allow redeclaring those on repeat runs. Change that declaration to 'var' instead and it'll keep working every time.
gui.kve.code.plain.file_missing: The script is looking for a file that isn't where it expects (%s) - check the path or name.
gui.kve.code.plain.generic_error: The game hit an error here. This is a technical message: if it doesn't make sense, copy the full line below and ask for help - the problem is usually a misspelled id, recipe or value.
gui.kve.code.plain.no_such_function: The script tried to call '%s', but that action doesn't exist on this object at all - the name is probably misspelled, from a different KubeJS version, or needs an addon that isn't installed.
gui.kve.code.plain.no_such_java_member: The script tried to use '%s' directly on a Minecraft/Forge object that doesn't have anything by that name - check the exact spelling and capitalization, or use the KubeJS method meant for this instead of setting it directly.
gui.kve.code.plain.not_a_function: The script tried to use '%s' as if it were an action/function, but it isn't one - check the name, it may be misspelled or the wrong kind of value.
gui.kve.code.plain.null_pointer: Something the script expected to exist came back empty - check the id/object used right before this error.
gui.kve.code.plain.reference_error: The script uses '%s' but that was never defined in this file - check that the name is spelled right or isn't missing a declaration.
gui.kve.code.plain.stack_overflow: The script ended up calling itself over and over without stopping (an infinite loop) - check the condition that's supposed to stop it.
gui.kve.code.plain.syntax_error: There's a syntax error in the script (a misplaced brace, parenthesis or comma, for example) - open the file and use 'Validate' to find exactly where.
gui.kve.code.plain.type_error_undefined: The script tried to use something called '%s' that didn't exist at that point (it came back empty) - check what was supposed to create it before this line.
gui.kve.code.plain.type_error_undefined_: The script tried to use part of something that didn't exist at that point (it came back empty) - check what was supposed to create it before this line.
